name: Hebrew Text Direction
author: Gilad
description: Shows Hebrew in reading order in Now Playing, the queue, the songs/albums/artists lists and the quick settings view. Works with the Hebrew Font mod. Firmware 4.5 only. Staged, with a self-disarming boot guard and an on-device reset tile.
changelog: 0.12: also loads into servicesd (quick settings / HUD host) with its own stage and guard files. 0.11: quick-settings tile to reset a tripped guard. 0.10: guard tolerates five unstable boots.
